title: At the Top of This Chairlift, Everyone Else Gets OLDER
description:
In this town, one day at the top of the chairlift costs a year down at the lake. People ride up to skip the winters and the waiting, and from the deck you can see them up top, standing still for days.

I've never been up. Gran goes up every morning with a blanket big enough for two, and comes down for Sunday dinner to tell me I look older. Then one Sunday she didn't come down.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: What would you ride to the top for an afternoon to skip?
